general.question: What is seedance.co?
general.answer: seedance.co is a cutting-edge AI video generation platform that allows you to transform text and images into high-quality videos in minutes. Powered by advanced models like Sora 2 and Veo 3.1, it enables creators to bring their visions to life without expensive equipment.

commercial.question: Can I use the videos for commercial purposes?
commercial.answer: Commercial use depends on the selected model's terms and the rights in your prompts and uploaded assets. Review the applicable provider terms before using generated content commercially.

aiModels.question: Which AI models do you use?
aiModels.answer: We integrate the industry's best video generation models, including Sora 2, Veo 3.1, and others. We continuously update our platform to include the latest and most capable models available.

credits.question: How does the credit system work?
credits.answer: You use credits to generate videos. The cost depends on the model, duration, resolution, and number of outputs. You can purchase a credit pack or choose a monthly, quarterly, or yearly subscription.

refund.question: Do you offer refunds?
refund.answer: We offer a satisfaction guarantee. If a generated video fails due to a system error, we will refund the credits. For subscription payments, please contact our support team within 7 days if you're not satisfied.

support.question: How can I get support?
support.answer: Email support@seedance.co and our support team will help you.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.introductionBody: Welcome to seedance.co. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
Privacy.collectionBody: We collect information you provide when you create an account, generate videos, make a payment, or contact support.
Privacy.usageBody: We use your data to provide and improve the service, process transactions, generate AI videos, prevent abuse, and maintain your account and transaction history.
Privacy.securityBody: We use appropriate technical and organizational safeguards to protect your personal information, although no internet service can guarantee absolute security.
Privacy.contactBody: For privacy-related questions, email us at <email>{address}</email>.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.acceptanceBody: By accessing or using seedance.co, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
Terms.licenseBody: You may use the service only in compliance with applicable law and the rights of others. You remain responsible for your prompts, uploads, and generated content.
Terms.disclaimerBody: The service is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. AI-generated results may be inaccurate, unavailable, or different from your expectations.
Terms.limitationsBody: To the fullest extent permitted by law, seedance.co and its suppliers are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from use of the service.
Terms.contactBody: For questions about these terms, email us at <email>{address}</email>.
